contradicting_evidence: Persistently weak participation, negative alt medians and continued ETH-relative weakness could develop into a clearer downside trend rather than prolonged uncertainty.
Repeated positive ETF sessions combined with sustained spot recovery and stronger ETH/BTC could establish an upside edge that the current packet cannot confirm.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: No supported net weekly direction can be assigned. A durable recovery would require persistent price improvement, stronger ETH/BTC, broader participation and repeated demand confirmation. Renewed contraction would require failed recovery attempts and continuing weakness across those same channels. Selective rallies or BTC resilience alone would not establish broad expansion, and no transition timing is supported.
falsification_conditions: A sustained sequence of BTC and ETH recovery, strengthening ETH/BTC, improving observed breadth and positive settled flows would replace NO_EDGE with an upside case.
Repeated failed recoveries accompanied by declining prices, deteriorating ETH/BTC, persistently weak breadth and renewed ETF outflows would replace NO_EDGE with a downside case.
Either reassessment must rely on persistent, aligned evidence rather than one rally, one flow session or an isolated capitalization-bucket outlier.
missing_evidence: A multi-day price, ETH/BTC and breadth sequence demonstrating persistence rather than isolated stabilization.
Further finalized ETF sessions establishing whether the latest positive session marks a durable change.
Updated settled BTC-dominance observations and evidence of stablecoin deployment.
Representative coverage below the Top-100 universe and contemporaneous catalyst or macro developments.

Observed capitalization-bucket participation is weak, but one 24h cross-section cannot establish a week-long contraction.
The structural prior supplies drawdown and partial-recovery context, not an independently confirmed weekly destination.
